description: The populated half of D4: with rules stored, `policies` lists what the boundary re-decoded (every row through the closed-set fail-closed read) and the `statement` field is ABSENT — the default-deny sentence belongs to the empty case only, so its presence here would claim a table that is not this one. `notAfter` renders as the instant the row carries, or null for a rule that never expires (PL7: no expiry is said, never skipped). No `spec` crosses the socket: the read window renders identity, not policy content.
